userStories.title: Judge response includes confidence and confidence_reason
acceptanceCriteria: Every judge response object contains confidence ∈ {low, medium, high} and a confidence_reason string
The prompt embeds the calibration instructions from Section 9.3 verbatim or semantically equivalent
Parsing fails loudly if confidence is missing or out-of-range

userStories.title: Batched call: 5 sessions per cheap-tier call
acceptanceCriteria: Pass-1 batches contain at most 5 sessions per call
Each session block in the batched prompt is preceded by a `--- session ${session_id} ---` separator
Session order within a batch is randomized

userStories.title: Batched response size validation and re-prompt
acceptanceCriteria: If the returned array length does not equal the input batch size, the batch is re-prompted exactly once
If the second attempt also fails, the batch falls back to one-session-per-call
A `[scorer] batch length mismatch` log line is emitted on each mismatch

userStories.title: Compressed transcript used in judge calls
acceptanceCriteria: The judge prompt sends the output of the transcript compression utility, not the raw transcript
The full raw transcript is still available locally for downstream substring validation
